name: Clock N' Stuff 2015

venue.name: [Crossroads UMC](http://www.crossroadswaunakee.org/)
venue.details: There is NO smoking on the property of the venue!!

information: The registration fee is $6 for your first event and $2 for each additional event. You MUST pre-register there will be NO at door registration. There is no fee for people to come and watch! The fees go towards the cost of running the competition, prizes, etc. Any funds beyond that go towards future competitions.
